Bulwark FR iQ Series Lightweight Cargo Pant, navy, QP14NV; in stock (dropship, 7-10 business days)

writeup: Woot has a single pair of Bulwark iQ Series lightweight flame-resistant cargo pants in navy, size 40W x 34L, for $7.99. The features match Bulwark's QP14NV: a left-leg snap cargo pocket, double articulated knees and a jean-style waistband. Workwear dealers AWA Work and Munro's Safety list the same pant at $71.99, so this is about 88% less while it lasts.
